segments.text: This is a supplemental video presentation for the case animal and plant biotechnology course.
segments.zh: 这是 CASE 动物与植物生物技术课程的补充视频讲解。

segments.text: As you view this video, be sure to make notes of important information.
segments.zh: 观看本视频时，请务必记下重要信息。

segments.text: Feel free to pause, repeat, and resume the video whenever necessary.
segments.zh: 必要时可以随时暂停、重播和继续播放视频。

segments.text: Lab notebooks, lesson 1.1, Foundations of Biotechnology.
segments.zh: 实验记录本　第 1.1 课　生物技术基础。

segments.text: You completed activity 1.1.1, Defining Biotechnology,
segments.zh: 你已经完成了活动 1.1.1“定义生物技术”，

segments.text: during which you explored the many applications of biotechnology.
segments.zh: 其间你探索了生物技术的众多应用。

segments.text: For previous courses, you utilized a binder to organize course materials.
segments.zh: 在以前的课程中，你用活页夹来整理课程资料。

segments.text: For the animal and plant biotechnology course, you will also use a new organizational tool, the laboratory notebook.
segments.zh: 在动物与植物生物技术课程中，你还将使用一种新的整理工具：实验记录本。

segments.text: This presentation provides information about how to set up your notebook and make entries throughout this course.
segments.zh: 本讲解介绍如何建立你的记录本，以及在整个课程中如何做记录。

segments.text: Part 2 of activity 1.1.2, Biotechnology notebooks, will walk you through the process of setting up your laboratory notebook.
segments.zh: 活动 1.1.2“生物技术记录本”的第 2 部分将带你一步步建立实验记录本。

segments.text: You will also use the laboratory notebook guidelines document.
segments.zh: 你还会用到实验记录本指南文件。

segments.text: First, set up the table of contents.
segments.zh: 首先，建立目录。

segments.text: Each entry should include the first page for each experiment and the first date for each experiment.
segments.zh: 每个条目应包括每个实验的起始页码和每个实验的开始日期。

segments.text: Leave through page 6 for the table of contents.
segments.zh: 把第 6 页之前的页面留作目录。

segments.text: You will record your first experiment's protocol beginning on page 7.
segments.zh: 你将从第 7 页开始记录第一个实验的方案。

segments.text: This will most likely be activity 1.2.3, Making Percent Solutions.
segments.zh: 这很可能是活动 1.2.3“配制百分比浓度溶液”。

segments.text: On each page of your notebook, you must have a page number, the title of your experiment, the date, your signature, and initials of a classmate verifying your records.
segments.zh: 记录本的每一页上都必须有页码、实验标题、日期、你的签名，以及核实你记录的同学的姓名缩写。

segments.text: Each lab entry needs to include a purpose, materials, quantities, and procedures for the experiment.
segments.zh: 每条实验记录都需要包括实验的目的、材料、用量和步骤。

segments.text: Record data such as reactions, conditions, and environmental factors in your notebook.
segments.zh: 把反应、条件和环境因素等数据记录在记录本中。

segments.text: Results, analysis, and conclusions will complete each experiment.
segments.zh: 每个实验最后以结果、分析和结论收尾。

segments.text: Recognizing that many experiments will take more than one class period to complete, or may require more than one page,
segments.zh: 考虑到许多实验需要不止一节课才能完成，或者可能需要不止一页，

segments.text: a system of numbering is used on every page of the notebook.
segments.zh: 记录本的每一页都采用编号系统。

segments.text: Any experiment that continues on a later page should include the phrase, go to page on the bottom right.
segments.zh: 任何在后面页面继续的实验，都应在右下角写上“转至第……页”。

segments.text: The phrase from page should be written at the top left of each page of a continued experiment.
segments.zh: 在续写实验的每一页左上角，应写上“接第……页”。

segments.text: Experiment pages may be separated by pages used to record other experiments,
segments.zh: 同一实验的各页之间可能隔着记录其他实验的页面，

segments.text: but you should never leave entire blank pages in the notebook.
segments.zh: 但记录本中绝不能留下整页空白。

segments.text: If a page is not completely filled, you should draw a slash through the white space, then sign and date the slash.
segments.zh: 如果某一页没有写满，应在空白处画一道斜线，然后在斜线上签名并注明日期。

segments.text: The laboratory notebook is used in industry to record precise protocol and data.
segments.zh: 在工业界，实验记录本用来记录精确的实验方案和数据。

segments.text: An accurate record of steps in an experiment will assist you and others in repeating the experiment to verify results.
segments.zh: 准确记录实验步骤，有助于你和他人重复实验以验证结果。

segments.text: Information contained within laboratory notebooks is also used to compile primary data for research articles and reports.
segments.zh: 实验记录本中的信息还会被用来汇编研究论文和报告的原始数据。

segments.text: These can be used to prove a patentable product or procedure.
segments.zh: 这些记录可以用来证明某种产品或方法具有可专利性。

segments.text: At the end of this course, you will be completing a unique and independent investigation, then reporting your results.
segments.zh: 在本课程结束时，你将完成一项独特的独立研究，然后报告你的结果。

segments.text: Your laboratory notebook will be a critical part of this inquiry activity.
segments.zh: 你的实验记录本将是这项探究活动中至关重要的一部分。

segments.text: Throughout the course, your teacher will use the laboratory notebook evaluation rubric to provide feedback before your notebook entries.
segments.zh: 在整个课程中，老师会使用实验记录本评分标准，对你的记录本条目提供反馈。

segments.text: Keep the guidelines document and evaluation rubric available when you discuss any questions you have with your teacher.
segments.zh: 在与老师讨论任何问题时，请把指南文件和评分标准放在手边。
